transcript: Speaker A: Hello, what is your name? Speaker B: My name is Pooja. Speaker A: Pooja, tell me what did you do this morning? Not library, it's pronounced library. R comes after B, brary. It's not berry, it's library.] Speaker B: Haan. Oh God, main to hamesha library bolti hoon. [Yes. Oh God, I always say library.] Speaker A: Koi baat nahi. Ek aur batao. Bete ke school mein kya hua? [No problem. Tell me another. What happened at your son's school?] Speaker B: Teacher ne bola ki uska pronounciation weak hai. [Teacher said his pronunciation is weak.] Speaker A: Aur tumhara bhi. Tabse muh nahi kholti. [Oh no. There's another problem. In PTA meetings, all moms speak in English. I stay quiet because I know my pronunciation is wrong. Once I said vehicle, everyone smiled. Since then I don't open my mouth.] Speaker A: Weh-hicle nahi, vehicle bolte hain. 'H' lagbhag silent hai. Par ab tumhe chup rehne ki zaroorat nahi hai.
